bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,json
name="gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1"
p=subprocess.run(["docker","logs","--since","4h","--tail","6000",name],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=18)
if p.returncode:
    print("VIDEOBOT_LOG_READ_FAILED")
    raise SystemExit(3)
lines=(p.stdout+"\n"+p.stderr).splitlines()
events=[]
for line in lines:
    l=line.lower()
    if "channel_post" in l or "my_chat_member" in l or ('"type"' in l and '"channel"' in l):
        ids=sorted(set(re.findall(r"-100[0-9]{7,}",line)))
        events.append({"type":"channel_post" if "channel_post" in l else "my_chat_member" if "my_chat_member" in l else "channel_meta","ids":ids})
print("SCANNED_LOG_LINES="+str(len(lines)))
print("CHANNEL_EVENT_MATCHES="+str(len(events)))
print("CHANNEL_EVENT_CANDIDATES="+json.dumps(events[-15:],ensure_ascii=False))
PY
